name: voiconomy-faucet
description: Virtualbabes Arena: The Multi-Chain NFT Seduction Faucet & Tournament Platform

scripts.wasm:build: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const env=Object.assign({}, process.env, {GOOS:'js', GOARCH:'wasm'}); const r=spawnSync('go',['build','-o','Public/main.wasm','.'],{stdio:'inherit',env}); if (r.error || r.status!==0) process.exit(r.status||1);"
scripts.wasm:init: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const cp=require('child_process'); const groot=cp.execSync('go env GOROOT').toString().trim(); let src=path.join(groot,'lib','wasm','wasm_exec.js'); if (!fs.existsSync(src)) src=path.join(groot,'misc','wasm','wasm_exec.js'); const dest=path.join(process.cwd(),'Public','wasm_exec.js'); fs.copyFileSync(src,dest); console.log('Copied', src, 'to', dest);"
scripts.server:build: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const env=Object.assign({}, process.env); delete env.GOOS; delete env.GOARCH; env.CGO_ENABLED='0'; const r=spawnSync('go',['build','-ldflags=-w -s','-o','server-bin','.'],{stdio:'inherit',env}); if (r.error || r.status!==0) process.exit(r.status||1);"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['Public/main.wasm', 'Public/wasm_exec.js', 'Public/styles.css', 'server-bin'].forEach(f => { try { fs.rmSync(f, { force: true }); console.log('Removed: ' + f); } catch (e) { if (e.code !== 'ENOENT') console.error('Error removing ' + f + ': ' + e.message); } });"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run wasm:init && npm run wasm:build && npm run sass:build && npm run server:build
